meta.description: Convert Pound per Sq. Inch (psi) to Bar (bar) instantly. 1 psi = 0.068947573 bar. Free, accurate, engineering-grade precision.

content.intro: Convert pound per sq. inchs (psi) to bars (bar) instantly. Both measure pressure, so the relationship is strictly linear: each pound per sq. inch equals 0.068947573 bars. Use the converter above for any value, or read on for the formula, a quick lookup table, and practical tips.
content.result_section: One pound per sq. inch is equal to **0.068947573 bars**. To go the other way, one bar equals **14.503774 pound per sq. inchs**. For everyday use, rounding to 2–4 decimal places is usually enough; for engineering or scientific work, keep the full precision shown by the converter.
content.formula_section:
The conversion is a single multiplication:

> bars = pound per sq. inchs × 0.068947573

Worked example — converting 10 pound per sq. inchs:

10 × 0.068947573 = **0.68947573 bar**.

To invert, divide by 0.068947573 (or multiply by 14.503774).

content.tips:
Keep the factor handy: 1 psi ≈ 0.068947573 bar. For rough mental math, round to the nearest sensible digit.

Mind the units. Pound per Sq. Inch and Bar both measure pressure; squared or cubic variants need a different factor (factor², factor³).

When precision matters (engineering, lab work, dosing), avoid rounding mid-calculation — convert once at the final step using the full factor.

**Q:** How many bars are in 1 pound per sq. inch?

**Q:** How do I convert bar back to psi?

**Q:** Is rounding to 2 decimal places accurate enough?
